description:
T1 - Oak - Reduce canopy spread 1 -2 meters back towards the fence line of the patio. Reduce height of fresh growth by up to 2 meters to create a more natural crown, thin out internal canopy removing any under developed shoots.

G1 - Ash Tree and 3x Sycamore over hanging neighboring property - Ash Tree currently shows good vitality, but has a very steep lean angle. Reduce height by 3 meters, prune overhanging branches to within the fence line, remove deadwood. 3x Sycamore Trees, reduce overhanging branches back towards the fem line to a good natural growth point, remove deadwood.

Normansfield Court -Front
T2. - Yew Tree - the tree has a very low leaf density and is dying, this should be considered for removal

T3 - Holm Oak Tree - Tree has already been pruned away from the guttering. Remove pruned stem and reduce by 1-2 meters remaining branches encroaching the property.
